title: Additive scanner range

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 1215545 (0x00128c39), HLP file offset 309806 (0x0004ba2e), topic 147 'Scanner Technology'
provenance.note: Scanner range formula and penetration classes.

setup.baseline: A ship with known scanners at a controlled distance from target fleets/planets.

procedure: Place one scanner and record detection range.
Combine two or three scanners and compare to the fourth-root formula.

documented: Ship scanner range is the fourth root of the sum of each scanner range to the fourth power; the same applies to planet-penetrating scanners (documented-only).
Non-penetrating scanners cannot detect fleets in orbit or reveal planetary statistics (documented-only).

unresolved: Exact scanner values are in the undecoded table.
Rounding of the fourth-root result is unknown.
